title: Blue Multifunctional Grinding Machine
body_html:
Product information :
Material: metal+plastic
5 inch blue grinder (aluminum motor) 1.8m long power cord.
Grinding wheel diameter is 125mm.
Power: 170W
Rotational speed: 2956R/min
Working system: 30min
Table grinder grinder, mainly used for metal processing, grinding/polishing scissors, drill bits, etc.



Packing list:
1* 5 inch blue grinder
1* 36 mesh grinding wheel
1* 80 mesh grinding wheel
8* screw
2* fully transparent PC goggles
2* tool rest
